name: youj-ui-core
title: Youj UI core
description: cn() (re-exported from youj-core), safeHref and safeLink (the links built from data), and ui.css: radius, density, focus, elevation, scrollbars (yj-scrollbar) and the reduced: variant, built on youj's colour roles. Import ui.css right after youj.css.

name: youj-look-bezel
title: Bezel look
description: The Bezel look: recipes keyed on data-yj-look="bezel" that change how components are built, with any theme. Import styles/bezel.css right after ui.css, then set look="bezel" on YoujProvider (or data-yj-look="bezel" on any element).

name: youj-shadcn-compat
title: shadcn compatibility
description: shadcn's token names (background, foreground, card, muted, primary, border, input, ring, sidebar...) on youj's colour roles, so code written for shadcn keeps working beside youj. Opt in: import styles/shadcn.css right after ui.css. shadcn's accent stays unmapped, since accent is youj's brand colour.

name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Base UI accordion.

name: account-menu
title: Account Menu
description: The signed-in user's menu: an avatar that opens a DropdownMenu with a profile header, the workspaces to switch between, your own rows (profile, settings, keyboard shortcuts), a Theme submenu and Sign out.

name: action-island
title: Action Island
description: A floating tray of actions over a canvas.

name: action-list
title: Action List
description: Things to act on, one per row: an icon tile in the row’s `tone`, a title and one line of `detail`, an optional `meta` chip (the date, amount or state that makes it urgent, in `metaTone`) and the row’s own `action`.

name: activity-rings
title: Activity Rings
description: Goals side by side as concentric rings: a day’s move, exercise and stand, a team’s quotas, a quarter’s key results.

name: alert-dialog
title: Alert Dialog
description: Base UI alert dialog: it asks before something happens.

name: alert
title: Alert
description: A status message in four severities.

name: allocation-meter
title: Allocation Meter
description: Budget envelopes as a rack of cells, one column each, draining from the top as money goes.

name: anchor-nav
title: Anchor Nav
description: A table of contents that follows the reader.

name: annotated-image
title: Annotated Image
description: A picture with numbered callouts joined by leader lines to labels in the gutters beside it.

name: app-header
title: App Header
description: The app's top bar (a navbar): brand, primary navigation (plain links or a MegaMenu), a search trigger for the command palette, actions and the account menu.

name: app-page
title: App Page
description: A page inside an app’s frame: the title, a line under it and the actions at the end, over the page’s sections on one gutter, so every page of the app starts at the same place.

name: aspect-ratio
title: Aspect Ratio
description: A box that keeps its shape as its width changes: the CSS aspect-ratio property, with the ratio as a number (16 / 9).

name: async-button
title: Async Button
description: A Button that runs async work on press and shows its whole lifecycle in place.

name: avatar-stack
title: Avatar Stack
description: Who is here: overlapping avatars (the Avatar primitives), the first `max` shown and the rest behind a "+N" that opens the full list in a Popover, with each person's role and status.

name: avatar-upload
title: Avatar Upload
description: A profile photo you can replace.

name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: Base UI avatar: the fallback shows until the image has actually loaded, and stays if it fails, so there is never a broken-image frame.

name: badge
title: Badge
description: A 20px pill in 12px medium type.

name: banner
title: Banner
description: An announcement bar across the top of a page or app: a launch, a maintenance window, a trial running out.

name: bottom-tab-bar
title: Bottom Tab Bar
description: A phone app's primary navigation, pinned to the bottom edge and padded by the safe-area inset.

name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: shadcn's breadcrumb in youj's type: a named `nav` around an ordered list, 13px muted crumbs, the current page in full ink (plain text with aria-current="page", not a link to itself), slanted hairline separators hidden from assistive tech.

name: breakdown-list
title: Breakdown List
description: How a total splits, as rows of a color marker, a name (with an optional line of `detail`), a value and its share of the total.

name: button-group
title: Button Group
description: shadcn’s button group: buttons, inputs and menus joined into one strip (role="group").

name: button
title: Button
description: Base UI button in six variants and eight sizes on the control-height scale (24/28/32/40px, +8px on touch).

name: calendar-heatmap
title: Calendar Heatmap
description: A habit’s days as heat dots: a column per week, a row per weekday, the newest week at the inline end (mirrored in RTL).

name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: A month grid on react-day-picker whose days and arrows are the library’s Button, so hover, press and focus match every other control.

name: capsule-player
title: Capsule Player
description: Now playing, in one capsule: cover art in a disc, the title and artist, a thin rail you can seek (a Base UI slider: arrows step five seconds, Home/End jump; spoken as “1:12 of 3:40”), the time played in mono, and previous, play and next.

name: capsule-search
title: Capsule Search
description: A search that waits as a small capsule with its shortcut on it and opens when it’s wanted.

name: capsule-stepper
title: Capsule Stepper
description: − value + in a capsule, for a number you nudge more than type.

name: capsule-toggle
title: Capsule Toggle
description: Two or three options in a capsule: a SegmentedControl whose track is the capsule itself, so the lit key glides inside the floating pill (motion’s SlidingIndicator on the smooth spring, retargeting mid-glide; it jumps under reduced motion).

name: capsule
title: Capsule
description: The shell every capsule shares: one row of controls or figures on a floating surface, the control height plus an inset that keeps the discs inside concentric with its ends.

name: card
title: Card
description: shadcn's card on youj surfaces: a hairline-bordered panel with a header (title, description, and an action slot beside them), content and a recessed footer.

name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: shadcn's carousel on Embla: swipe, drag and flick, looping, and responsive slides per view (a basis on each item).

name: cell-bar
title: Cell Bar
description: A total built from its periods: a cell per month, each as wide as its amount, solid when settled and hatched when projected.

name: chart
title: Chart
description: shadcn's chart on Recharts, colored by the theme and timed by youj.

name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: Base UI checkbox.

name: choice-card
title: Choice Card
description: A selectable card: icon, title, description and its control, with the whole card as the target.

name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
description: Base UI collapsible: a trigger with aria-expanded / aria-controls and a panel that wears motion's yj-collapse preset (height to the measured size, then auto, with the content fading; a reversal mid-way continues from where it is).

name: color-opacity-field
title: Color Opacity Field
description: A color and its opacity as one grouped control: a swatch that opens the Color Picker, a hex field that reads 3, 4, 6 or 8 digits (pasted or typed), and an opacity percentage you can drag.

name: color-picker
title: Color Picker
description: A color picked in a Popover: a saturation/brightness area, a hue Slider on a spectrum, hex and OKLCH fields, swatches (the theme presets’ accents by default) and the browser’s eyedropper where it exists.

name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: A single-select picker with search, composed from Popover and Command: the popup grows out of the trigger on yj-pop, the active row glides, the list eases its height, and the chosen row draws its check.

name: command-palette
title: Command Palette
description: A ⌘K palette on CommandDialog: groups, nested pages with a breadcrumb back stack (Backspace on an empty search or Escape steps back; the last Escape closes), recent items, results loaded as you type, and a footer that spells out the keys.

name: command
title: Command
description: cmdk, re-skinned: a flush search row over a list.

name: context-menu
title: Context Menu
description: Base UI context menu: right click, long press, or the Menu key / Shift+F10 on a focused row.

name: contribution-list
title: Contribution List
description: A waterfall told as a list: the `baseline` row, each thing that moved the figure as a signed step (`items`: an icon, a label, a line of `detail`, +n or −n), and the `total` row, highlighted.

name: countdown
title: Countdown
description: Days, hours, minutes and seconds to a moment, in tabular figures under their unit names.

name: coverage-matrix
title: Coverage Matrix
description: How well each row is covered by each column: every cell fills from the bottom by depth in its column’s color, and a cell with nothing is hatched.

name: currency-swap
title: Currency Swap
description: A converter card: what you pay (an amount field and its currency) over what you receive (the converted amount, rolling digit by digit), each with its value below, a round button that flips the two sides, the rate and the primary action.

name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
description: A date you can type or pick: an InputGroup field in the locale’s short format (a complete date selects as you type; it also reads “Sep 27, 2026”, ISO and today/tomorrow) and a calendar button that opens the Calendar in a Popover (yj-pop, then the month slide).

name: date-range-picker
title: Date Range Picker
description: A span of days: two typed fields (start – end) under one label, and a Popover with presets beside a two-month range Calendar (one month and a row of presets on phones).

name: day-rail
title: Day Rail
description: A trip on one rail, a column per day.

name: day-ring
title: Day Ring
description: A day of scheduled runs on a 24-hour dial (`role="img"`, described in words): midnight at the top, clockwise, a quarter-hour ruler with the elapsed part of the day shaded, and one thin track per job with its runs as arcs as long as they take (ticks when they have no duration).

name: density-lanes
title: Density Lanes
description: When things happen, one lane per kind: each column swells above and below the lane’s spine by its value, on one scale for every lane, over a faint grid of dots.

name: dial
title: Dial
description: A bounded value on a ruled arc: a three-quarter ring ticked at every step, the value as an ink knob on the band and large in mono in the middle.

name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: Base UI dialog.

name: diff-bar
title: Diff Bar
description: Two values of one measure, A against B, as a diverging bar: each side grows out from a shared center toward its own end, in cells, with the values in mono at the outer ends.

name: distribution-strip
title: Distribution Strip
description: How sampled requests spread across latency: every sample is a dot on a log-scaled strip, stacked into rows where they crowd, with the percentiles (p50, p90 and p99 by default) as flagged hairlines and the objective as a dashed line; past it the strip is hatched and its dots take the warning tone.

name: dot-map
title: Dot Map
description: The world as a grid of dots, lit where the numbers are: each region lights the land dots around it like LEDs, the reach and strength growing with its share of the largest value, under a soft halo in its tone (the accent unless it sets one).

name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: Base UI drawer: a modal panel on an edge that follows the finger and dismisses when swiped towards that edge (drag the handle with a mouse).

name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown Menu
description: Base UI menu.

name: empty
title: Empty
description: An empty state: what isn't here yet, why, and what to do next.

name: field
title: Field
description: Field is Base UI's Field.Root with shadcn's layout parts.

name: file-upload
title: File Upload
description: Files in, with the whole lifecycle shown.

name: filter-chips
title: Filter Chips
description: A filter query as chips (`label:bug`, `priority:in(p1,p2)`) with a field for the next one, in a filled well.

name: flow-graph
title: Flow Graph
description: A graph of steps that lays itself out along the flow, showing each step’s state.

name: flow-lanes
title: Flow Lanes
description: Where a stream goes: one source fans out to a lane per destination, each ending beside its name and rate.

name: forecast-band
title: Forecast Band
description: Where a running total will land against a budget.

name: form
title: Form
description: react-hook-form (with any resolver, zod here) wired into Field and AsyncButton, with shadcn’s part names (FormField, FormItem, FormLabel, FormControl, FormDescription, FormMessage).

name: gauge
title: Gauge
description: One bounded score at a glance: a thin half-ring on a scale of ticks, read left to right, the value in its bowl and a word for its band underneath, between the range’s ends (`role="meter"`).

name: gradient-slider
title: Gradient Slider
description: A value on a spectrum.

name: hatched-bar
title: Hatched Bar
description: Solid for what is settled, hatched for what isn’t: a baseline, a pending or projected amount, a run that missed its gate.

name: histogram-range
title: Histogram Range
description: A two-thumb range over the distribution it filters.

name: history-strip
title: History Strip
description: Availability a day at a time: one slim cell per day, oldest at the inline start and today at the end (mirrored in RTL).

name: hours-dial
title: Hours Dial
description: A stretch of the day on a 24-hour face: midnight at the top, a ruler of quarter-hour ticks all the way round, and two handles on it, a hollow start and a solid end.

name: hover-card
title: Hover Card
description: Base UI preview card: a preview of where a link goes, after resting on it (500ms) or focusing it.

name: image-accordion
title: Image Accordion
description: A row or column of pictures where one is open wide and the rest wait as slim strips.

name: image-compare
title: Image Compare
description: Two pictures stacked with a divider between them: `before` shows on the start side (or the top) up to the divider, `after` past it.

name: inline-confirm
title: Inline Confirm
description: A button that confirms in its own place instead of opening a dialog.

name: input-group
title: Input Group
description: One bordered frame around a bare text control and its addons (text, icons, keycaps, buttons) on the inline or block edges.

name: input-otp
title: Input OTP
description: A one-time code field for 2FA and email verification.

name: input
title: Input
description: Base UI input (a field control, so inside a Field it is labeled, described and validated automatically). 32px on the control scale, 13px text (16px on touch so iOS never zooms).

name: inspector-panel
title: Inspector Panel
description: One property group of a design tool’s side panel.

name: item-pager
title: Item Pager
description: Steps through the records of a list from a detail panel: ↓ opens the next row, ↑ the previous one, and "5 of 48" says where you are.

name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: A keycap: a recessed tint with a hairline and a 1px bottom edge for depth, in 11px medium type on a 20px square minimum.

name: label
title: Label
description: A plain `<label>` for use outside a Field (inside one, use FieldLabel, which wires itself).

name: lane-meter
title: Lane Meter
description: Load across the lanes of a queue or a pipeline as stacked rows of countable cells that share one grid, so lanes compare at a glance: a label, the cells, the value (with a lane’s own capacity muted, “24 / 32”) and an optional action.

name: level-matrix
title: Level Matrix
description: Roles by resources, each cell an access level (none, read, write, admin) drawn as three segments lit to it.

name: limit-meter
title: Limit Meter
description: A budget read like an instrument (`role="meter"`): what is left, large, with its decimals quiet; the spent and the limit as a quiet readout under it; and a ruler of minor and major ticks from zero to the limit, with an index caret under it at the spend and named lines for policies such as a freeze.

name: live-cursors
title: Live Cursors
description: Multiplayer presence for a collaborative surface.

name: lollipop-chart
title: Lollipop Chart
description: Many items on one value scale, each a dot on a stem from a baseline, in its tone.

name: mega-menu
title: Mega Menu
description: Multi-column panels for a NavigationMenu: groups of links with an icon tile, a title and a line of description, and an optional featured card at the inline end.

name: menubar
title: Menubar
description: A desktop-app menu bar on Base UI Menubar.

name: milestone-ruler
title: Milestone Ruler
description: A year (or any span of days) as a ruler of fine ticks, each milestone a pin standing on it: taller when major, solid when done, hollow when upcoming, in the warning tone when at risk.

name: multi-select
title: Multi Select
description: Several values from a searchable, grouped list, composed from InputGroup, Badge chips, Popover and Command checkbox rows.

name: native-select
title: Native Select
description: The browser’s own <select>, dressed as a Youj field: Input’s border, hover and focus ring, the control heights and Select’s chevron.

name: navigation-menu
title: Navigation Menu
description: Base UI's navigation menu.

name: notification-center
title: Notification Center
description: A bell with an unread count that opens your notifications: a Popover on desktop, a bottom Sheet below the md breakpoint.

name: number-input
title: Number Input
description: Base UI’s NumberField as an InputGroup with − / + InputGroupButtons: Intl parsing and formatting in the locale (currency, percent, units), min/max, `step` and `largeStep` (Shift+arrows), press-and-hold on the buttons, and no wheel changes unless `allowWheelScrub`.

name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: shadcn's pagination: a named `nav` of links, the current one marked aria-current="page".

name: password-input
title: Password Input
description: A password field with a reveal toggle, a strength meter and a requirements checklist, composed inside one Field.

name: phone-input
title: Phone Input
description: A phone number in one InputGroup: a country Select (flag, calling code, typeahead by name) and the national number, formatted as you type from a per-country pattern.

name: popover
title: Popover
description: Base UI popover.

name: progress-list
title: Progress List
description: File transfers in flight, one row each: a run of cells that lights as the bytes move, what has moved of the size, the live rate and time left in mono, and pause, resume and cancel per row (Retry on a failed one).

name: progress-path
title: Progress Path
description: A course as a winding trail of lesson nodes, grouped into sections that each take a chart color and close on a trophy milestone.

name: progress
title: Progress
description: Base UI progress (role="progressbar" with a formatted aria-valuetext).

name: property-list
title: Property List
description: A record's properties as rows of icon, label and value: a description list (`dl`, `dt`, `dd`), with a fixed label column and values that truncate.

name: proposal-card
title: Proposal Card
description: A change someone (or an agent) proposes and a person decides on: where it came from, what it is, the options side by side with the proposed one as a dashed accent outline, the impact as figures, and your actions.

name: radar-chart
title: Radar Chart
description: Several things scored on the same axes, one filled shape each, so what one has more of than another reads at a glance.

name: radial-graph
title: Radial Graph
description: What one thing reaches, in rings by how many hops away: each branch a wedge, each dot in its kind’s color, and a solid or dashed ring with a matching link for a node’s state, so a path shows at a glance.

name: radial-menu
title: Radial Menu
description: A pie menu: a ring of actions that fans out around the pointer, one icon per circular slot, with a hub that names the highlighted one.

name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: Base UI radio group: one tab stop, arrow keys move the selection (and wrap), Space selects.

name: rating
title: Rating
description: A rating in stars, or any Youj or lucide-style icon, in whole or half steps.

name: refill-meter
title: Refill Meter
description: A rate limit’s token bucket as cells you can count: one per token (or a share of the capacity), lit while the token is in the bucket.

name: resizable
title: Resizable
description: shadcn's resizable on react-resizable-panels 4: horizontal and vertical split groups that nest, with min / max sizes (px, %, rem) and collapsible panels that snap shut past their threshold.

name: rollout-ruler
title: Rollout Ruler
description: How far a feature has rolled out, on a ruled track cut into its stages (Internal 1%, Beta 5%, 10%, 50%, GA 100% by default), each an equal stretch so the early cohorts get room; the axis says what each gate is worth.

name: route-map
title: Route Map
description: A route on a drawn map with no tiles: abstract land, water, parks and roads in the theme’s tones, and routes as smooth lines in their state: driven, on time, delayed (danger) or proposed (a dotted accent line nobody has accepted yet).

name: score-ring
title: Score Ring
description: A score out of a range as a full ring of fine ticks, lit clockwise from the top up to the score, the tick at the score reaching past the rest.

name: scroll-area
title: Scroll Area
description: Base UI's scroll area: native scrolling (wheel, touch, and the keyboard once the viewport has focus) with thin overlay scrollbars that fade in while you hover or scroll and fade away on the slow token after.

name: scrub-number-field
title: Scrub Number Field
description: A compact number you can drag.

name: seat-map
title: Seat Map
description: A venue from above: the stage, then rows of seats bending round it with aisles, the row’s letter at both ends.

name: segmented-control
title: Segmented Control
description: One choice out of a few, always made: plain labels on a hairline, with a 2px accent bar that glides to the pressed segment on the smooth spring and retargets mid-flight (`variant="pill"` makes it a recessed track with a raised key).

name: segmented-meter
title: Segmented Meter
description: How full a resource is, in cells you can count (`role="meter"`): a label and its value on one line, a row of discrete cells under them, lit from the inline start.

name: segmented-ring
title: Segmented Ring
description: An interval workout on one dial: every interval an arc as long as it lasts, round the ring clockwise from the top inside a ruler of ten-second ticks.

name: select
title: Select
description: Base UI select: typeahead, Home/End, and by default the macOS-style popup that lines the selected item up over the trigger.

name: separator
title: Separator
description: A hairline in the border token with role="separator" and aria-orientation from Base UI.

name: session-timeout
title: Session Timeout
description: Warns before an inactive session signs out, for banking, admin and health apps.

name: severity-timeline
title: Severity Timeline
description: An incident, event by event (`ol`): each row has its clock time and how long after the start it came, a node on a rail (a dot in its severity’s tone, a diamond for a milestone), a soft SEV chip, the title and the detail.

name: share-bar
title: Share Bar
description: A word-sized share of a whole for a table cell or a list row: a solid bar, or a run of cells (`segments`) for the dense, counted look.

name: share-dialog
title: Share Dialog
description: Share one thing with people and by link, Google-Drive style.

name: share-ring
title: Share Ring
description: A whole split into its parts, as a dial of cells: a dish’s calories by macro, a budget by category, a day by activity.

name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: A panel that slides in from an edge: a positioned Base UI Dialog (modal, focus-trapped, Escape and the scrim close it, focus returns to the trigger). motion’s yj-sheet-* slides it fully off its edge, decelerating in on the slow token and accelerating away on the base token; reversing mid-slide continues from where it is.

name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: shadcn's sidebar, re-skinned.

name: signature-pad
title: Signature Pad
description: One self-contained surface to sign on: full-width Draw | Sign by typing tabs on top, the signing area under them, and a footer with Undo and Clear (quiet icon buttons) and Accept.

name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: A recessed block with a band of light crossing it on the shimmer loop: three deliberate beats per cycle (cross, then rest), so it reads as a calm pulse rather than a constant wash.

name: slide-to-confirm
title: Slide To Confirm
description: A confirmation that takes a deliberate gesture: drag the thumb to the end of the track.

name: slider
title: Slider
description: Base UI slider: direct manipulation, so the thumb tracks the pointer 1:1 and keyboard steps land instantly, as on a native range.

name: slot-grid
title: Slot Grid
description: A week of bookable times you can read at a glance: a column per day, a row per start time, and in each cell a run of pips (one per place, up to eight) lit for the places still free.

name: sortable-list
title: Sortable List
description: A vertical list the user puts in order, on the same motion/react layer as Kanban.

name: sparkline
title: Sparkline
description: A word-sized trend line: a monotone curve (it never overshoots a point), a wash under it and a dot on the latest value, in plain SVG.

name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: youj's LoaderRingIcon: a constant-rate turn with an arc that breathes on a different period, so the loop never visibly repeats.

name: stage-rail
title: Stage Rail
description: A pipeline run as one segmented rail.

name: stat-card
title: Stat Card
description: Analytics tiles built like an instrument readout.

name: stat-pill
title: Stat Pill
description: One live figure in a capsule: an icon in a recessed disc, its name as a mono eyebrow, the value in mono with its unit small and muted, then how it moves, a delta (an arrow and the change, tinted by `better`: a fall in latency is good) or a word-sized trend with a dot on the latest reading.

name: stepper-nav
title: Stepper Nav
description: Step navigation for flows that span pages: Stepper in a named nav landmark, with done steps and the current one as links back to their pages (Stepper's `stepHref`).

name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: Where you are in a sequence: each step is complete, current, upcoming or in error, and can be optional.

name: switch
title: Switch
description: Base UI switch (role="switch").

name: table
title: Table
description: The plain table parts: header, body, footer, row, head, cell and caption.

name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Base UI tabs with a kinetic indicator: one motion SlidingIndicator per list glides to the selected tab on the `smooth` spring (transform-only, retargets mid-glide, re-places without motion on resize, jumps under reduced motion).

name: tag-input
title: Tag Input
description: Free-form values as Badge chips in an InputGroup.

name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: A textarea rendered through Base UI's field control, so it is labeled, described and validated exactly like Input.

name: theme-toggle
title: Theme Toggle
description: Light or dark for the whole page, through `data-theme` on <html>.

name: time-lanes
title: Time Lanes
description: Who is on call when, as a week of lanes: a lane per person or team in the chart colors, each shift a bar, overrides hatched, a dashed baton where one lane hands off to another, and now as an accent line that glides with the clock.

name: time-picker
title: Time Picker
description: A time as segments in one InputGroup frame: hours, minutes and (on a 12-hour clock) AM/PM, each a spinbutton.

name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: An activity feed: events grouped by day, newest first, each with a typed mark on a rail (commit, comment, deploy, alert, merge, pull request, or your own), who did it and a relative time that stays true.

name: toast
title: Toast
description: Base UI toasts with motion’s yj-toast stack.

name: toggle-group
title: Toggle Group
description: Base UI toggle group: one tab stop, arrow keys rove (and wrap), Home/End jump, Space/Enter press.

name: toggle
title: Toggle
description: Base UI toggle: a two-state button with aria-pressed.

name: toolbar
title: Toolbar
description: Base UI Toolbar: a row of buttons, toggles, links and inputs that is one tab stop, roved with the arrow keys (wrapping at the ends).

name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: Base UI tooltip: a short visual label on hover or keyboard focus.

name: tour
title: Tour
description: Guided coach-marks: a dim scrim with a rounded cut-out over one element at a time and a card beside it with the step’s title and text, the count (“2 of 5”, and dots), Back / Next / Done and Skip.

name: track-timeline
title: Track Timeline
description: Tracks of clips on a time ruler, to move, trim and snap, with mute, solo and a level strip per track.

name: treemap
title: Treemap

title: Unit Chart

name: waffle-chart
title: Waffle Chart

name: waveform-scrubber
title: Waveform Scrubber

name: wheel-picker
title: Wheel Picker
description: A drum of values you spin: one or more columns, the chosen row of each in one band across the middle, the rows above and below curving away and fading.

name: wizard
title: Wizard
description: A multi-step flow on the Stepper: one step at a time with Back and Continue.

name: workspace-switcher
title: Workspace Switcher

name: world-clock
title: World Clock
description: Several time zones side by side, to find a time that works for everyone.

name: audio-recorder
title: Audio Recorder
description: Record a voice note or an audio clip, listen back, then keep it or not.

name: chat
title: Chat
description: Composable parts for AI chat and assistant interfaces: a message list that stays with a streaming answer, messages with actions, streamed markdown, a composer, thinking and reasoning, tool calls, citations, suggestions and an empty state.

name: code-block
title: Code Block
description: A block of code on a recessed panel: a header with the file name or language and a copy button, then the code, highlighted as tokens (never HTML) and scrolling sideways instead of wrapping.

name: data-table
title: Data Table
description: The parts a data table on TanStack Table v9 is built from: a column header that sorts, pins, moves, hides and resizes its column, a toolbar with a search, filters with counts and their chips, the columns menu, pagination, a checkbox column and the bar a selection raises.

name: diff-viewer
title: Diff Viewer
description: The difference between two versions of a file, as code review reads it.

name: export-dialog
title: Export Dialog
description: Choose what leaves and in which shape, then export it.

name: filter-builder
title: Filter Builder
description: Builds a query of AND/OR groups of typed rules, such as “Stage is not Lost and (Owner is Ada or Amount > 100000)”.

name: hierarchy-chart
title: Hierarchy Chart
description: A hierarchy drawn as a tidy tree (Reingold–Tilford): an org chart, a team of teams, any parent-and-children structure.

name: import-mapper
title: Import Mapper
description: Bring a CSV into an app in two screens: drop a file, then see each column with the field it goes to, fix only the rows with problems and say what happens to duplicates, and import with a button that states what will happen.

name: kanban
title: Kanban
description: A kanban board composed from Card, Badge, Button, Input and ContextMenu.

name: multi-language-input
title: Multi Language Input
description: One field for text in many languages, from two locales to forty: the value is `Record<locale, string>` and the control edits one locale at a time, named “Title, German” and marked with its `lang` and `dir`.

name: tree-view
title: Tree View
description: A WAI-ARIA tree with one Tab stop: ↑ ↓ move, → opens or steps in, ← closes or steps out, Home / End, * opens every sibling, typing jumps to a matching name, Enter activates, Space selects or checks, F2 renames, Shift+F10 opens the context menu.

name: voice-orb
title: Voice Orb
description: A voice agent’s presence: a clean, softly lit sphere in the theme’s accent, from a light tint to a deep shade of it.

name: whiteboard
title: Whiteboard
description: A whiteboard for sketching and arranging: pen, line, arrow, rectangle, ellipse, text, sticky notes that grow to fit, connectors that re-route when the shapes they join move (straight or elbow, with labels), embeds holding any React node, and comment pins that open your thread in a popover.

name: use-announcer
title: useAnnouncer
description: A polite live region for changes a screen reader wouldn't otherwise hear (a chip removed, a selection cleared, a tag moved). Render `announcer` once, from the first render, since several screen readers ignore a live region that arrives with its message already inside; then call `announce(text)`. Saying the same thing twice is still announced.

name: use-audio-meter
title: Use Audio Meter
description: Null where Web Audio is missing.

name: use-controllable-state
title: useControllableState
description: State that is controlled when `value` is defined and the component's own otherwise. The setter only writes the internal copy when uncontrolled; the caller reports the change (onValueChange) itself, with whatever extra arguments it has. `null` is a controlled empty value; `undefined` means uncontrolled.

name: use-mobile
title: useIsMobile
description: True below the `md` breakpoint. Read synchronously on the client (no desktop-first flash); false on the server.

name: use-now
title: useNow
description: The current time in ms, refreshed every `refresh` ms (0: never). It is null on the server and in the hydration render: the server's clock and time zone aren't the browser's, so anything relative to now ("5 min ago", "Today") or in local time waits for the browser. Components mounted after hydration get the time on their first render. While the tab is hidden it stops ticking, and refreshes as soon as the tab is shown again.

name: use-resize-measure
title: useResizeMeasure
description: Runs `measure` with the element once it is laid out, then again each time its box resizes. Where there is no ResizeObserver (old browsers, some test runners) it measures once. `deps` are the effect's, as in `useLayoutEffect`.

name: use-stroke
title: useStrokeInput
description: The outline of a stroke of varying width, as a closed polygon.

name: use-visible
title: useVisible
description: Whether the element is on screen and its tab is showing. A block's timers and loops (a live clock, a simulated feed) run only then, so one scrolled away or left in a background tab costs nothing.

name: activity-comment-thread

name: activity-doc-comments

name: activity-inbox

name: activity-version-history

name: app-step-path

description: Guide people along a trail of steps in sections, with progress beside it: the step up next, total points toward the next level, the week’s streak and today’s goal.

name: app-step-trace
title: App Step Trace
description: Watch one run work through its steps, then open any step to see what it was given and what it produced.

name: app-step-tracker
title: App Step Tracker
description: Follow anything that moves through a run of stages, replayed live on one rail with the time and place of every scan: a parcel, a loan, a visa.

name: app-streaks
title: App Streaks
description: Keep a run of days on anything: the picked item’s streak with its milestones, its last 26 weeks as dots where today’s dot is the toggle, and today’s list.

name: app-support-chat
title: App Support Chat
description: Give your customers a place to ask for help with a floating support chat widget.

name: app-switchover
title: App Switchover
description: Watch a primary source hand over to its backup: it sags and fails its checks, the load moves step by step onto the backup, and you switch back once the primary is steady, with every step on a timeline.

name: app-task-board
title: App Task Board
description: Help your team track tasks through their stages with a Kanban board, a sprint summary above it and a card for every task.

name: app-team-members
title: App Team Members
description: Manage workspace members, roles and pending invitations with seat usage in view.

name: app-terrain-calendar
title: App Terrain Calendar
description: Show months of days as an isometric terrain: every day a column as tall as its measure, so busy stretches rise as ridges, quiet weeks sink to valleys and one standout day stands alone.

name: app-tiered-capacity
title: App Tiered Capacity
description: Compare how full each region is, tier by tier, as a block of columns: a column climbs its dashed case as it fills, and the panel gives what is used, what is left and when it runs out.

name: app-tile-board
title: App Tile Board
description: Watch a set of things as tiles in your own statuses and handle the one status that needs someone: a timer, the reason as one choice, who is coming and when, the escalation countdown, then escalate or resolve.

name: app-track-arranger
title: App Track Arranger
description: Arrange a project from its parts: move and trim clips, mute or solo a track, and set each clip’s volume.

name: app-transfer-list
title: App Transfer List
description: Follow transfers in flight so you can see what is still on its way: an overall meter, a row each with its rate and time left, and pause, resume, cancel or retry.

name: app-usage-charges
title: App Usage Charges
description: Show what a workspace used and what it was charged: a date range, a project filter and Export CSV over the total, the days as stacked bars by SKU with a tooltip, and a table of SKUs with usage against the allowance, the part past it, the charge and a total row.

name: app-usage-overview
title: App Usage Overview
description: Track your cloud spending against a budget with a projected bill, usage breakdown and invoices.

name: app-voice-call
title: App Voice Call
description: A call with a voice agent: its name and what it is doing, the call clock, a VoiceOrb, the caption line, mute, the speaker volume beside a meter of the voice, and End call, which leaves the call ended with how long it lasted and Call again.

name: app-webhooks
title: App Webhooks
description: Manage webhook endpoints with delivery status and subscribed events visible in one table.

name: app-week-blocks
title: App Week Blocks
description: A week of logged time as columns, one per day: rounded blocks in the color of their kind, today marked with a now line and its time, the week total large and a legend that gives the totals per kind.

name: app-week-calendar
title: App Week Calendar
description: Plan your week with a calendar page: the week’s events on a time grid, what’s up next today, and a Slot Grid to find a free hour.

name: app-week-dial
title: App Week Dial
description: The week as a clock: a ring per weekday, arcs for the entries in the color of their kind round a nine-to-six dial, a now hand with its time, the headline kind in the middle and the week total with a legend underneath.

name: auth-device-authorization
title: Auth Device Authorization
description: Let someone approve a command-line tool or device from the browser: who is asking, what it can do, the account it would use, the code to compare with the terminal and a plain safety note.

name: auth-forgot-password
title: Auth Forgot Password
description: Help your users get back into their account with a form for requesting a password reset link.

name: auth-login
title: Auth Login
description: Welcome returning users with a sign-in page offering social login or email and password.

name: auth-magic-link-sent
title: Auth Magic Link Sent
description: Show your users where to look next after they request a passwordless sign-in link.

name: auth-reset-password
title: Auth Reset Password
description: Help your users choose a new password with clear rules, a strength indicator and confirmation.

name: auth-shell
title: Auth Shell
description: Frame your sign-in screens with a centered card or a split page with room for artwork.

name: auth-signup
title: Auth Signup
description: Give new users a sign-up page with social login or a name, email and password form.

name: auth-two-factor
title: Auth Two Factor
description: Guide your users through a verification code with clear feedback when it succeeds or needs another try.

name: commerce-cart-drawer
title: Commerce Cart Drawer
description: Let shoppers review their cart in a floating panel without leaving the product page: photos, quantities, the road to free shipping and checkout.

name: commerce-checkout
title: Commerce Checkout
description: Guide shoppers through contact details, shipping and payment with an order summary in view.

name: commerce-order-detail
title: Commerce Order Detail
description: Help your customers check their order and see where it is on its way to them.

name: commerce-product-card
title: Commerce Product Card
description: Show a product the way an editorial shop does: the photo is the card.

name: commerce-product-detail
title: Commerce Product Detail
description: Let shoppers see a product from every side in the color they pick, choose their size, and know when it will arrive.

name: commerce-product-grid
title: Commerce Product Grid
description: A shop’s catalog on real photographs: category tabs with live counts, a Saved view, filters with chips, a wide featured tile, and a quick view whose photo flies out of its tile and back.

name: commerce-product-render
title: Commerce Product Render
description: Show your product photos as one studio shoot: catalogue tiles and hero images that keep the product in frame at any aspect, fade up when loaded, crossfade between colorways and close in on a detail.

name: commerce-subscription-checkout
title: Commerce Subscription Checkout
description: Guide your customers from choosing a subscription to payment with a running order summary.

name: content-blog
title: Content Blog
description: Give your journal a magazine-style home with an article view for reading each story.

name: content-changelog
title: Content Changelog
description: Keep your users up to date with release notes organized by version and date.

name: content-docs
title: Content Docs
description: Help readers navigate your documentation with a page tree and an outline beside each article.

name: content-help-center
title: Content Help Center
description: Help your customers find answers with live search, topic cards and a contact form.

name: content-illustrated-states
title: Content Illustrated States
description: Give the in-between pages a friendly face: a welcome, an empty workspace, a 404, maintenance, a finished payment and offline, each with a fitting illustration you can swap.

name: content-roadmap
title: Content Roadmap
description: Share what you are planning with a public roadmap and a place for feature requests.

name: forms-multi-step
title: Forms Multi Step
description: A multi-step application whose steps follow the answers: a summary of problems at the top of a step, people added as cards, save and finish later, and Check your answers with a Change for each step before it’s sent.

name: forms-payment
title: Forms Payment
description: Payment details in one card: card fields that know their brand and hand focus on as they fill, a billing address in the country’s own order with a lookup on its first line, and a business purchase’s tax number checked in the country’s format.

name: forms-settings
title: Forms Settings
description: A settings section with a save bar: every change is marked with its own Reset, the bar counts them and saves with ⌘S, Discard has Undo, and unsaved changes survive a closing tab or a link elsewhere in the app.

name: forms-support
title: Forms Support
description: A support request that helps before it’s sent: the topic decides the fields, help articles appear while the subject is typed, files upload with progress, and the reply time follows the team’s real hours in the requester’s own clock.

name: frame-account-card
title: Frame Account Card
description: Put account details within reach with a sidebar card that opens your account menu.

name: frame-account-menu
title: Frame Account Menu
description: Give your top bar an avatar menu for profile settings, help and signing out.

name: frame-account-status
title: Frame Account Status
description: Let your users set their availability from an account menu in the top bar.

name: frame-notifications
title: Frame Notifications
description: Keep updates close with a notification bell and a list you can filter or mark as read.

name: frame-search-field
title: Frame Search Field
description: Help your users find a page with a top-bar search field that suggests matches as they type.

name: frame-search-palette
title: Frame Search Palette
description: Put pages and common actions within reach with a command palette in your app frame.

name: frame-shell
title: Frame Shell
description: Build your app around a shared layout for the sidebar, top bar and page content.

name: frame-sidebar-classic
title: Frame Sidebar Classic
description: The app sidebar most products start from, close to shadcn’s: a filter, labeled sections, icons and counts, nested pages, a folding Favorites group, pages for the foot, a meter and the account.

name: frame-sidebar-glass
title: Frame Sidebar Glass
description: For data tools, file systems and knowledge bases: the kit Sidebar’s glass surface over a backdrop of the theme’s inks, a nav column beside an explorer with a filter and a tree to any depth.

name: frame-sidebar-icon-rail
title: Frame Sidebar Icon Rail
description: For products with a handful of areas: a slim floating rail of icons with names in tooltips, the current one raised, the account at the foot.

name: frame-sidebar-rail-panel
title: Frame Sidebar Rail Panel
description: For products with many areas: round keys for the sections on a slim rail, beside a panel with the section’s title, a view toggle, a filter and its pages as a tree with count pills.

name: frame-sidebar-workspace
title: Frame Sidebar Workspace
description: For products people run their day in: raised white rows on the gray chrome, a command field with go-to keys, counts on one column, folding spaces, optional live state, and a setup card at the foot.

name: frame-topbar-breadcrumb
title: Frame Topbar Breadcrumb
description: Show your users where they are with a breadcrumb top bar that keeps search and account controls close.

name: frame-topbar-minimal
title: Frame Topbar Minimal
description: Keep the focus on your page with a top bar for its title, notifications and main action.

name: frame-topbar-search
title: Frame Topbar Search
description: Put search at the center of your app with a top bar that gives it room.

name: frame-topbar-tabs
title: Frame Topbar Tabs
description: Help your users switch between page views with tabs beneath the page title and actions.

name: frame-upgrade-card
title: Frame Upgrade Card
description: Show plan usage and an upgrade option in a sidebar card your users can dismiss.

name: frame-workspace
title: Frame Workspace
description: Let your users switch teams with a searchable workspace menu in the sidebar.

name: marketing-about
title: Marketing About
description: Tell the company’s story as something to scrub through: a rail of years under a growth line, where each year rolls the figures to how they stood and swaps the chapter in.

name: marketing-careers
title: Marketing Careers
description: List the open roles so people find theirs: teams as tabs with live counts, a search that marks its words, a location filter, rows that line up their place, kind and salary band, and an open application at the end.

name: marketing-contact-sales
title: Marketing Contact Sales
description: Let a visitor book a sales call the way a good scheduler does, one question at a time: a day and a time with the person their region puts forward, then three short rows of details, then a confirmation; or a message instead.

name: marketing-cookie-consent
title: Marketing Cookie Consent
description: Let visitors choose their cookie preferences with a banner they can reopen later.

name: marketing-cta-banner
title: Marketing CTA Banner
description: Give visitors a next step between sections with a slim call-to-action banner.

name: marketing-cta-form
title: Marketing CTA Form
description: Turn interest into an inquiry with a form for work email and team size beside your pitch.

name: marketing-cta-headline
title: Marketing CTA Headline
description: Close your page with a bold headline and a prominent button for the next step.

name: marketing-cta-proof
title: Marketing CTA Proof
description: Close with a ledger of customer results and the words behind them, ending on the reader’s own line and the call to action.

name: marketing-cta
title: Marketing CTA
description: Give your landing page a closing call to action with a headline, reassurance and room for a secondary link.

name: marketing-customer-story
title: Marketing Customer Story
description: Tell a customer story as a long read: the results as counting figures with a before and now bar, the story in chapters with a contents that follows the reader, a pull quote and the next story.

name: marketing-faq
title: Marketing FAQ
description: Answer common questions like a small help center: a search that marks its words and opens the answer that matched, topics with counts, a deep link for every answer, and “Was this helpful?” under each.

name: marketing-feature-bento
title: Marketing Feature Bento
description: Show what your product does with a grid of varied tiles and small working demos.

name: marketing-feature-grid
title: Marketing Feature Grid
description: List your features in a ruled grid, each read off a live instrument that takes a new reading when it’s pointed at.

name: marketing-feature-spotlight
title: Marketing Feature Spotlight
description: Show your features in action with alternating text and interactive demos.

name: marketing-feature-steps
title: Marketing Feature Steps
description: Explain how your product works as a release you can watch: a lens rides the track from step to step, each picture plays its moment as it arrives, and visitors can pick any step.

name: marketing-feature-tabs
title: Marketing Feature Tabs
description: Let visitors explore your features in tabs with a large demo for each choice.

name: marketing-footer
title: Marketing Footer
description: Round off your site with a sitemap: grouped links with tags, a newsletter sign-up, trust badges, legal links, a language switch and a live status pill.

name: marketing-hero-centered
title: Marketing Hero Centered
description: Introduce your product with a centered headline and calls to action over a soft animated background.

name: marketing-hero-collage
title: Marketing Hero Collage
description: Open with a release in flight: a desk of live interface cards that change state stage by stage, with a tour you can take over and a caption that tells the story in words.

name: marketing-hero-editorial
title: Marketing Hero Editorial
description: Give your landing page a journal-style opening with large type, a byline and supporting figures.

name: marketing-hero-motion
title: Marketing Hero Motion
description: Open with a headline that rises word by word over a pointer-reactive dot matrix, beside a live panel where visitors change speed, reduced motion and theme and watch a real checklist answer.

name: marketing-hero-product
title: Marketing Hero Product
description: Put your product preview at the heart of your landing page with a browser frame beneath the headline.

name: marketing-hero-split
title: Marketing Hero Split
description: Pair your opening pitch with the product in a window, and let the selling points steer it: each point sends the window’s camera to its part of the screen, where that part plays its moment.

name: marketing-hero-terminal
title: Marketing Hero Terminal
description: Introduce your command-line tool with a copyable install command and an animated terminal demo.

name: marketing-integrations
title: Marketing Integrations
description: Show what your product connects to: searchable, categorised cards with a status each, and a detail sheet for the connection, with its health and sync history.

name: marketing-logo-cloud
title: Marketing Logo Cloud
description: Show who uses the product under one quiet line: a grid that trades its logos in place, one cell at a time, or a row that drifts with no seam.

name: marketing-metrics
title: Marketing Metrics
description: Back your claims with numbers that come with context: figures that count up for a chosen period, the change on the one before, a trend line, a baseline to compare with and a footnote for the source.

name: marketing-navbar-docs
title: Marketing Navbar Docs
description: A documentation header: a version menu, ⌘K search over every page, the repository with its stars and the sections as tabs, with a drawer of the page tree on phones.

name: marketing-navbar-floating
title: Marketing Navbar Floating
description: A floating island of navigation that draws in around its links as the page scrolls under it, follows the section in view, steps aside while you read and grows into its own menu on phones.

name: marketing-navbar-fullscreen
title: Marketing Navbar Fullscreen
description: A slim bar whose Menu opens the whole screen: large entries that rise into place, levels that drill in and back with focus kept in step, a picture that follows the entry you point at, and the small print at the foot.

name: marketing-navbar-store
title: Marketing Navbar Store
description: A shop’s header: a strip with the promise and the region, departments with collection tiles, a search that suggests products priced in your currency, and a bag whose count drops in.

name: marketing-navbar
title: Marketing Navbar
description: Help visitors find their way with mega menus that morph from panel to panel and preview each destination, media cards, search, an announcement bar, signed-in and signed-out states, and a drawer with folding sections on phones.

name: marketing-not-found
title: Marketing Not Found
description: Give visitors a way forward with a not-found page, its lighthouse sweeping the fog, or a coming-soon page with a launch sign-up.

name: marketing-pricing-compare
title: Marketing Pricing Compare
description: Help visitors compare plans with a feature table that keeps prices and sign-up buttons in view.

name: marketing-pricing-picker
title: Marketing Pricing Picker
description: Help visitors choose a plan with seat controls and a summary that updates the total as they choose.

name: marketing-pricing-simple
title: Marketing Pricing Simple
description: Present a single plan with its price, included features and a choice of currencies.

name: marketing-pricing-usage
title: Marketing Pricing Usage
description: Help visitors estimate their bill with usage sliders and a cost breakdown that updates as they drag.

name: marketing-pricing
title: Marketing Pricing
description: Help visitors choose a plan with monthly or yearly prices and a feature comparison.

name: marketing-product-comparison
title: Marketing Product Comparison
description: Put your product beside the alternatives in one table: a sticky head with price, coverage and a call to action, grouped features that explain themselves, a switch for only the differences, and one alternative at a time on a phone.

name: marketing-product-tour
title: Marketing Product Tour
description: Let visitors try the product instead of watching it: a rail of steps beside a live window of real components, with each step checked off as they do its thing and a progress line that fills.

name: marketing-security
title: Marketing Security
description: Answer a security review in one place: live status with a strip of daily uptime, certifications with a report on request, data residency with a map, the practices behind it and the policy documents.

name: marketing-social-proof
title: Marketing Social Proof
description: Show who else uses your product in one section: a rating summary, customer wordmarks on a hairline grid lit by the pointer with an industry filter, and the featured customer story as an editorial panel whose results roll up.

name: marketing-solutions
title: Marketing Solutions
description: Speak to each buyer on one page: pick a role and an industry, and the pitch, a customer quote, the call to action, the live numbers and the activity feed all change to match.

name: marketing-team
title: Marketing Team
description: Introduce the people behind the product: portraits that look designed even without a photo, each with their local time, a bio that rises over the portrait on hover, focus or a tap, and a team filter that re-flows the grid.

name: marketing-testimonial-wall
title: Marketing Testimonial Wall
description: Let customers make the case in their own words: columns of quotes drifting past each other with no seam, a column that stops when pointed at while the others recede, one button to pause the whole wall, and the phrase that matters in each quote set in full ink.

name: marketing-theme-playground
title: Marketing Theme Playground
description: Let visitors re-theme a small landing page live, with a preset, accent, corners, control size and style.

name: marketing-waitlist
title: Marketing Waitlist
description: Build interest before launch with a waitlist page, a countdown and a referral link.

name: marketing-whats-new
title: Marketing Whats New
description: Show that the product keeps moving: the newest change as a feature card, earlier changes as a dated list with kind tags and expandable details, an area filter and a way to load more.

name: media-attachments
title: Media Attachments
description: A reply box that takes files while you write: paste, drop or attach, each uploading with a ring as it goes; arrange them by dragging or with the keyboard; and Send waits for uploads still running instead of sending without them.

name: media-dropzone
title: Media Dropzone
description: A drop zone that takes files every way people have them: dropped or picked whole folders (read recursively, system files left out), pasted screenshots, and plain picks from the keyboard.

name: media-image-editor
title: Media Image Editor
description: An image field that shows exactly how the picture will look everywhere it appears: move, zoom, turn, straighten and flip it under a fixed frame, mark its focal point, and watch live previews of every size it’s shown at.

name: media-library
title: Media Library
description: A media picker that’s as quick from the keyboard as with a mouse: search, filter, folders, grid or list, an ordered selection with a maximum, a lightbox that grows from its tile, and uploads dropped straight into the open folder.

name: media-upload-tray
title: Media Upload Tray
description: Uploads that keep going while people keep working: drop files anywhere on the page, and a tray in the corner runs the queue a few at a time, pauses and resumes each from where it got to, retries with a countdown, waits out a lost connection, and gives an honest time left.

name: surveys-builder
title: Surveys Builder
description: Build a survey and put it in front of people: an outline you reorder by drag or keyboard, fourteen kinds of question, editing in place with show-if logic, a live preview on a phone or a desktop, design, undo and autosave, a test run in any layout, and Publish to a link, an embed or in-app, with a schedule and a share card.

name: surveys-conversational
title: Surveys Conversational
description: A survey asked one question at a time, keyboard first: letters pick choices, digits pick a point on a scale, Enter goes on.

name: surveys-deck
title: Surveys Deck
description: A survey for the phone in your hand: a deck of question cards with answers as large as a thumb, thrown aside to go on or back (or moved with the two buttons where the thumb rests), progress in segments along the top, and the cards still ahead peeking out below.

name: surveys-form
title: Surveys Form
description: A survey on one page: every question numbered in one column, logic revealing and hiding questions in place, progress counting what’s answered, and a send that gathers every problem in a summary linked to each question.

name: surveys-question
title: Surveys Question
description: One question anywhere in your app, in any type the survey builder offers: a rating under an article, a poll, a check-in after a chat.

name: surveys-results
title: Surveys Results
description: What a survey heard: responses, completion and the median time, then any question’s answers in the shape its type calls for, NPS first with its split of detractors, passives and promoters.

name: surveys-widget
title: Surveys Widget
description: A short survey in a corner of your product: it rises in without taking focus, asks one question at a time and keeps one size while it does, folds into a pill and back, and sits along the bottom edge on a phone.

name: tables-bulk-actions
title: Tables Bulk Actions
description: Work through rows in bulk: filter by either status, channel, date or amount, select a few, and a command bar runs the actions you define (the demo fulfills, prints, marks paid, refunds after a confirmation that names the count, archives or exports), each with its own key and every action in a menu you can search.

name: tables-data-grid
title: Tables Data Grid
description: The complete records grid, for records with a face and a pulse: a rich cell for every kind of value (an identity with its logo, a status, tags, a meter, a trend line, money in tabular mono, relative dates, people as avatars, a switch, a copyable id, a link), views as tabs, filters as chips, grouping with totals, detail panels under rows and cards on a narrow screen.

name: tables-data-table
title: Tables Data Table
description: The complete dense table, for records people scan, compare and manage: your columns and rows with search, filters as chips, saved views, selection with bulk actions, inline editing, CSV export, server mode and virtualization.

name: tables-grouped
title: Tables Grouped
description: Planned against spent as a tree: lines grouped the ways you define (the demo: a budget by team, category or owner), each group summing its plan, spend, variance and share used down to a grand total.

name: tables-logs
title: Tables Logs
description: A live event stream, virtualized for thousands of rows: it follows new events while you read from the top and holds still (counting what waits) when you scroll down or pause.

name: tables-records
title: Tables Records
description: Work a list of people like a CRM: faces and organizations, a stage you change right in its cell, an owner, a score, an amount, the last touch, and tags, with views you define, a panel under each row, and a selection bar to assign, tag, export or delete.

name: tables-spreadsheet
title: Tables Spreadsheet
description: Rows that work like a spreadsheet (the demo: a stock sheet): edit any cell in place, read the active cell in the name box and formula bar, paste a block of cells from Excel or Google Sheets (checked per column), undo and redo with ⌘Z and ⇧⌘Z, and keep the totals in view as you scroll.
